notes: Read all 7 source lines before editing. The web module is a barrel re-exporting analytics tab building blocks: L1 export {HeroGauges} from './HeroGauges'; L2 export {OverviewTab} from './OverviewTab'; L3 export {DrivingTab} from './DrivingTab'; L4 export {ChargingTab} from './ChargingTab'; L5 export {BatteryTab} from './BatteryTab'; L6 export type {TabKey} from './constants'; L7 export {TAB_KEYS} from './constants'. All 7 exported names are preserved by the native barrel (HeroGauges, OverviewTab, DrivingTab, ChargingTab, BatteryTab, type TabKey, TAB_KEYS).

The web tab siblings (HeroGauges/OverviewTab/DrivingTab/ChargingTab/BatteryTab/constants) are NOT yet present in the native parity tree (only the deeper ChargingDetailSection sibling has been converted), so this follows the established native sibling-less-barrel precedent (web-parity/components/charts/index.ts, features/admin/components/devtools/index.ts): a SELF-CONTAINED .ts barrel that reimplements every export with React.createElement (JSX requires .tsx). L6 TabKey and L7 TAB_KEYS are ported verbatim from web constants.tsx ('overview'|'driving'|'charging'|'battery'); module-local PIE_COLORS + QUICK_LINKS are also ported (QUICK_LINKS lucide icons dropped as browser-only).

L1 HeroGauges ported faithfully from web HeroGauges.tsx: the 6-MetricCard grid (Distance/Drives/Energy/Efficiency/Gas Savings/CO2 Saved) with the totalDist convertDistanceFromSI(total_distance_km*1000) floor, the KM-tied gasSavings = total_distance_km*0.085*1.5 - safe(total_cost) and co2Saved = total_distance_km*0.12 heuristics, Math.max(gasSavings,0), and the !data branch of 6 MetricSkeletons. lucide icons -> tone dots; native MetricCard lacks subtitle/color so a tone-dot MetricTile carries the web color + subtitle.

L2 OverviewTab ported from web OverviewTab.tsx + its OverviewVehicleComparison child: Distance-by-Vehicle bar, Fleet Usage donut, Efficiency Leaderboard (sorted-by-efficiency BarRows with pct fill), Vehicle Comparison radar (normalized per-metric multi-series, <2 vehicles -> empty), Energy & Activity bars, Day-of-Week + Monthly-Cost composed charts, and the Quick Links list (react-router <Link> -> non-interactive native rows, fallback labelKey.split('.').pop()). All recharts collapse to AreaChartWrapper; vehicle distance/energy keep convertDistanceFromSI floors and every i18n key/fallback is preserved.

L3 DrivingTab ported from web DrivingTab.tsx + DrivingPerformanceCards + DrivingTemperatureStats: the 6 performance MetricTiles (top/avg speed via fromKmh, peak power/regen, avg/longest distance via fromKm), Speed/Trip-Distance/Duration distribution bars, Hourly Pattern (hour:00 xFormatter), Temp-vs-Efficiency scatter (mapped temp/efficiency/distance), Daily Trend + Efficiency Trend (effTrend useMemo filter safe(efficiency)>0, date.slice(5) xFormatter), and the inside/outside Temperature Stats grid. convertSpeed/Distance/TempFromSI floors preserved; empty branches keep their web messages.

L4 ChargingTab ported from web ChargingTab.tsx: the 6 summary MetricTiles (sessions/totalEnergy/totalCost via formatCurrency/avgPower/avgDuration/chargeEff with power_stats/duration_stats/efficiency_stats null '-' fallbacks), Charger Types donut, Start Battery Distribution bar, Hourly Charging Pattern composed chart, and reuse of the already-converted native ChargingDetailSection sibling (imported from './ChargingDetailSection') unchanged. L5 BatteryTab ported from web BatteryTab.tsx: the trend.length===0 empty panel, the 5 health MetricTiles (healthScore/capacity via formatEnergy/degradation/estRange via fromKm/cycles from the latest trend point), and the Health Timeline / Capacity / Range (range=fromKm(range_km)) / Degradation-&-Cycles charts.

Native-safe shims preserve behavior/units/i18n: useTranslation -> t(key, fallback)=fallback; useUnits/useFormatting/lib unitConversion -> ported convertDistance/Speed/Temp/EnergyFromSI + formatEnergy + fmtNumber/fmtInt/formatCurrency('$'+fmtNumber) using the web no-settings defaults (metric km/km/h/°C/kWh, locale en-US, currency '$'); safe + CHART_COLORS from the native chartUtils parity. GlassPanel's required children prop is satisfied via a panel() Fragment wrapper. nativeAnalyticsBarrelCapabilities documents the unavailable surfaces (charts flattened to AreaChartWrapper, Quick Links navigation unavailable without a router, metric unit defaults without a settings store). No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, lucide-react, or old web UI components are imported.

Gates from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean exit 0; npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint . --quiet) clean exit 0; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles green. Commit scoped to apps/native for this file only.
